title: EarnProof Deployment Manifest
description: Schema for EarnProof contract deployment manifests (scripts/*.json). Enforces required fields, Stellar address patterns, SHA-256 hash patterns, network enum, manifestVersion, and forbids secret material at the top level.

manifestVersion.description: Schema format version integer. Starts at 1 and is incremented on every breaking schema change. See docs/schema-versioning.md.

network.description: The Stellar network this manifest targets.

deployedAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time of when the deployment was performed.

admins.description: Optional per-contract admin G-addresses. Present when contracts were initialized with different admin keys.

source.description: Free-form identifier for the deployer account or tool.

contracts.description: Deployed contract IDs on the target network.

wasm.description: WASM artifact metadata for each contract.

initialIssuer.description: The issuer registered during deployment initialization.

issuerIdHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the issuer ID.

metadataHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the issuer's public metadata.

schemaVersions.description: On-chain schema version IDs approved in the protocol-config contract during this deployment.

transactions.description: Optional map of transaction names to Stellar explorer URLs.

explorer.description: Optional map of contract names to Stellar Lab explorer URLs.

commands.description: Optional list of shell commands used during deployment, for documentation purposes.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes about the deployment.

wasmEntry.description: WASM artifact record for a single contract. Requires path and sha256; allows additional metadata fields.

path.description: Relative path to the compiled WASM artifact.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the WASM artifact.
